description: Check source-backed insurance requirements for Uber, Uber Eats, Uber Black, Lyft, DoorDash, Amazon Flex, Instacart, Grubhub and Skip in all US states, DC, Canadian provinces and territories. Provide an ISO jurisdiction such as US-CA or CA-ON and every platform used. Optional vehicle, ownership, commercial-driver status, city, New York licence category, comprehensive/collision, delivery days and annual delivery kilometres identify conditional gaps. Returns driver requirements, local-rule scope, platform trip-stage cover, unresolved items, source sections and research dates. This is a checklist, not proof of coverage or platform availability. Uses the same deterministic rules as /driving-insurance/checker; no customer data or saved submissions.

city.description: Operating city, used to identify Boston, Hamilton, Portland and NYC qualifications. Does not establish local licensing compliance.

commercialDriver.description: True for a commercially licensed livery, taxi, black car or TCP operation, even when accepting economy trips.

jurisdiction.description: ISO region, e.g. CA-ON, US-CA or US-NY. All 50 states, DC, 10 provinces and 3 territories are supported.

newYorkOperation.description: For US-NY: ordinary state TNC, TLC/licensed for-hire, or unknown.

name: check_driving_insurance
title: Check rideshare and delivery insurance requirements
